description:
About our brand and products:
Sunny Paw Shop is a premium pet lifestyle brand focused on thoughtfully designed essentials for small dogs. We specialize in carriers, harnesses, and accessories made with breathable, lightweight materials and a refined aesthetic. Our products are designed with comfort, fit, and everyday usability in mind, especially for toy and small breeds.

What makes us different:
We design specifically for small dogs, not scaled-down versions of large dog products. Our focus is on quality materials, intentional details, and clean design that fits seamlessly into everyday life. Each product is carefully developed to balance comfort, function, and style, with an emphasis on proper fit and wearability.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn a commission on every qualifying sale made through their unique referral link. Commissions are competitive and paid on confirmed orders. Higher commission rates, exclusive promotions, and gifting opportunities may be available based on performance and partnership.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote SunnyPawShop through social media posts, stories, short-form video, blog content, or product reviews. We encourage authentic content that shows real-life use of our products and honest recommendations. Lifestyle, pet, and aesthetic-driven content performs especially well.

Other information:
We value long-term partnerships built on trust and transparency. Affiliates are expected to follow all platform guidelines and disclose affiliate relationships where required. For any questions, support, or collaboration opportunities, our team is happy to assist.
